title: Croatian Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy take on traditional chicken skewers, inspired by the rich culinary heritage of Croatia.

ingredients.name: Chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Boneless and skinless, for best results

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.
Transfer skewers to a plate and garnish with parsley, if desired.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side, if desired.
